summary: 55 units checked word by word against the Sanskrit. 43 issues: 15 error, 28 minor; 33 units need fixes, 22 are ok. Main findings: notes carrying Ṛgveda parallels (797, 798, 814, 826); splits at -vat and -tama (789, 827); a wrong split tubhyam+imā (777); a genitive turned into a locative (779); verbs/objects supplied in one language only (783, 818, and the u particle in 786); glossary terms (droṇa 785, madhu 822, kratu 790, satpati 827, arka 796); no ordinary typos beyond those already flagged. Manual decisions: 813 (stomavāhasaḥ number, low confidence); vṛṣā = bull vs mighty one across units; the indu name/drop and brahman priest Hindi (ब्रह्मन् vs ब्रह्म-पुरोहित) conflicts in the glossary. No regrouping suggested. All outputs are unreviewed AI drafts.
